verdict.rationale: Intel publishes its own SDKs and toolkits aimed at Core Ultra series 2 processors: oneAPI with oneDNN and PyTorch optimizations, VTune Profiler for the client GPU and NPU, and the DPC++ CUDA-to-SYCL tool. The 285K spec page also lists OpenVINO among the supported AI frameworks. The evidence is short marketing snippets only, with no hands-on or community confirmation of building against these SDKs on this chip. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK docs or API references specific to the 285K, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Maximize AI PC inference capabilities from large language models (LLM) to image generation with Intel® oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library (oneDNN) and PyTorch optimizations for Intel® Core™ Ultra processors (series 2)
Optimize performance on client GPUs and NPUs from Intel with new analysis tool features in Intel® VTune™ Profiler.
AI Software Frameworks Supported by CPU OpenVINO™, WindowsML, DirectML, ONNX RT, WebNN
